title: A48 Run Context Card (extracted)
description: Schema for the parsed/normalized representation of A48_run_context_card.md. The on-disk file is markdown — either a Markdown table (| Field | Value |) or a bullet list (- `Field`: Value). Both formats normalize to the same dict shape, defined here. Parser: governance.schemas.loader.parse_a48(path). Enforcement points: hooks/pre_bash_promote.sh (CurrentStage extraction) and any future write-time A48 validator.

RunID.description: Unique identifier for this engagement run. Free-form but must be non-empty.

RequestType.description: Optional human-readable label for the engagement variant (e.g., 'bsa_pack_direct_mixed_sources').

Mode.description: Which top-level workflow this run uses. Set by /bsa-start --mode flag.

CurrentStage.description: Where the workspace is in the pipeline right now. Updated by orchestrator after each stage promotion. `discovery.complete` is the terminal discovery state after D5 + D-Exit; main cycle starts when stage1.ready is also emitted.

SelectedPath.description: Optional path-family routing label (e.g., 'process', 'structural', 'mixed'). Used for path-aware skill behavior.

CanonPolicyVersion.description: Same shape as marker.canon_policy_version: bare semver or semver+hash.

InScope.description: Free-form scope statement. May be a single string or a bullet list collapsed into a string by the parser.

OutOfScope.description: Free-form anti-scope statement. Same format conventions as InScope.

EntryCondition.description: Free-form precondition statement for stage activation.

x-bsa-supported-source-formats._comment: The on-disk A48 may use either of these markdown shapes; parser normalizes both.
